status: opt-in T1 fact/correction producer and V4 semantic evidence path integrated; learned capability not evaluated

implementation.input: exact raw UTF-8 bytes plus per-byte Taiji PerceptEvent features from the committed InputTrace
implementation.learnable_path: producer-owned byte embedding, projection, bidirectional recurrent context, BIO slot head and utterance-act head; old detached PerceptEvent features are auxiliary inputs, not claimed as updated by semantic loss
implementation.parameter_owner: input_semantic_producer; its fit-only span/act loss reaches producer parameters; joint_learning receiver schema recognizes this owner
implementation.query_goal_commit: query can select an already-known entity/attribute fact and exact query source into Workspace for V4; it does not retrieve episodic memory. Goal remains a candidate and does not update GoalState/ActionIntent
implementation.source_binding: every span is bound to input_id, full-source SHA-256, half-open UTF-8 byte offsets, exact percept event IDs, assembly IDs and a producer revision
implementation.commit: only a current-model output with a resolved assertion/correction can update WorldObject/WorldEvent; correction replaces one matching object attribute and preserves event history and unrelated entities
implementation.language_consumer: the selected semantic feature is added to V4 workspace with its exact source span; a source-row cut changes next-byte logits in the deterministic structural fixture
implementation.checkpoint: producer weights and parse ledger are stored in a separate versioned component of the same NativeCheckpoint as the joint state and V4 candidate
implementation.multi_turn: canonical CognitiveState can be rebound to a TSK-v8 native checkpoint before the next InputFrame; a second-frame correction retains the first parsed fact

limits.parse_logits_fixture: commit-path intervention tests use a fixed-logit test double; this verifies source, state and consumer contracts, not semantic accuracy
limits.semantic_ability: not measured; the parser candidate is untrained
limits.language_loss_credit: V4 consumes detached producer semantic features; language loss is not claimed to update the producer, which currently receives only explicit train-partition span/act labels
limits.act_commit: assertion/correction update source-bound WorldObject/WorldEvent; a query can select an existing entity/attribute fact and its exact source for V4; goals remain hypotheses and do not create GoalState/ActionIntent
limits.T2_T3_natural_input: query-to-episodic-memory retrieval and natural Goal-to-action mapping remain unimplemented; current T2/T3 paths still use structured fixtures
limits.checkpoint_training_state: weights and parse ledger are saved; optimizer/RNG/update continuation is not implemented because no training occurred

architecture_verdict: The previously missing input producer now has a source-bound learnable candidate and an actual semantic feature path into the V4 decoder. Structural tests establish wiring and recovery only; no claim of Chinese fact extraction quality or learned capability follows.
next_development_step: N177.5: freeze the T1 F0/F1 beginner course, family split, same-parent controls, CPU/wall budget, checkpoint policy and finite stopping line before any training authorization. T2 query retrieval and T3 goal parsing remain deferred until those task slices are activated.
